text:
Mae G: Quick sync — launch checklist for next week. need a prioritized list: keywords, schema, sitemap, redirects, internal linking, and webinar landing routing. who owns what?

Santiago: I can take keyword mapping and content clusters. will share spreadsheet later today. thinking of focus keywords: "llm inference platform", "low-latency llm serving", "inference cost optimization".

Olivia: I'll own schema and metadata. can we decide on FAQ schema + Product schema for the launch page? also need OpenGraph for social.

Rosalind: redirects need to be prepped — we have some legacy docs returning 404s. can we get a redirect plan + nginx rules? simple example: 
```
# redirect old docs to new docs
location = /docs/old-deploy {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.inference/docs/deployments;
}
```
I'll run a crawl and send a CSV of old->new paths.

Julian: internal linking map: recommend 3 pillar pages, then cluster pages linking back. I'll draft a link map CSV: source_page, target_page, anchor_text. sample row: 
`/blog/benchmarking-gpu-pools,/docs/dedicated-capacity,Redwood Dedicated`

Mae G: @Olivia how important is JSON-LD vs microdata for our CMS? and can we add automatic FAQ injection for the webinar page?

Olivia: JSON-LD only — easier to maintain. for webinar page: include event schema + registrationAction. sample: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference — Launch Webinar","startDate":"2025-05-12T16:00:00Z","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OfflineEventAttendanceMode","offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/webinar"}}
```
I'll add to the template.

Santiago: For keywords — prioritize high-intent: "inference at scale" and "LLM serving latency SLA". I'll tag each content piece with primary/secondary/LSI in the sheet.

Rosalind: Redirect rules question — do we prefer 301 for all old docs? some are temporary. I propose 301 for canonical moved content, 302 for A/B test copies.

Mae G: Agree on 301 for permanent. add a column in the CSV for status_code. also include canonical header recommendations.

Julian: For internal linking, let's also add cross-product CTAs: "Try Dedicated" -> /signup/dedicated. need dev to confirm routing behavior (so clicks land in right flow).

Mae G: Inbound lead routing: whoever owns the webinar form -> map UTM + form hidden field for product interest, route to Sales queue: dedicated vs hosted. @Rosalind can you add hidden field wiring in the form?

Rosalind: Yep. will add `product_interest` hidden input and map to SFDC via GTM event. I'll post GTM snippet.

seo-bot: Crawl complete: 243 pages checked, 19 404s, 7 duplicate title warnings, 12 missing meta descriptions. Detailed report uploaded to /drive/seo-launch-2025.

Olivia: Messaging iteration — once keywords mapped, target H1/H2, meta description drafts for each page. can the content team do quick 200-300 word intro updates?

Santiago: I can mark priority pages for the content team. top 10: homepage, dedicated, private, console, optimize, docs/deployments, blog/benchmark, blog/cost-optim, webinar landing, pricing.

Mae G: Great. owners: 
- Keywords/content clusters: Santiago
- Schema & OG: Olivia
- Redirect CSV + nginx rules: Rosalind
- Internal linking map & CTAs: Julian
- Inbound routing + GTM wiring: Rosalind + Marketing Ops
- Messaging/meta drafts: Content team (assigned by Santiago)

Olivia: Timeline check — schema + OG by EOD Wed, redirects CSV by Thu noon, link map by Thu EOD, keyword sheet by Wed night.

Mae G: OK will compile and create PR for the sitemap + canonical update. once PR is ready we'll schedule a quick review Fri 10am.

Santiago: posting sheet shortly.

Rosalind: starting crawl fixes now, will ping when nv redirect CSV is ready.

Julian: adding link map skeleton to the shared drive.

Mae G: thanks team :thumbsup: if anyone runs into blockers ping me and I'll escalate with engineering for routing/CORS issues on the webinar form.
